name: skljoc-worker
description: Your own place for Škljoc uploads: a Cloudflare Worker in front of R2, with views, private links, passwords and expiry.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

UPLOAD_TOKEN.description: The password Škljoc uses to upload. Generate a long random one with `openssl rand -hex 32`, and paste the same value into Škljoc → Settings → Upload.

BUCKET.description: Where uploads are stored. Use an existing bucket name to keep everything in one place.

DB.description: Keeps views, privacy, passwords and expiry for each upload.
